title: Brill--Noether existence and rank for graphs through genus six
summary: This repository proves Baker's Brill--Noether existence conjecture for finite graphs of genus at most six. The conjecture states that if G is a finite connected loopless multigraph, with genus defined to be g = E-V+1, then for all nonnegative integers d, r, there exists a configuration of d chips on G with Baker--Norine rank at least r provided that the Brill--Noether number rho = g - (r+1)(g-d+r) is nonnegative.
